title: authentication-service: Login requests intermittently returned HTTP 503 during peak
error_type: Login requests intermittently returned HTTP 503 during peak traffic.
symptoms: Login requests intermittently returned HTTP 503 during peak traffic.
evidence: Database connections reached the configured maximum during the incident.
Application logs showed unreleased database connections.
The background authentication worker was confirmed to retain connections after failed transactions.
verification: Verified database connections returned to normal.
HTTP 503 errors stopped after the fix.
resolution_steps: Fixed the connection release logic in the authentication worker.
root_cause: The database connection pool was exhausted because an authentication background worker opened database connections and did not release them after failed transactions.
resolution: Fixed the connection release logic in the authentication worker.
symptom: Login requests intermittently returned HTTP 503 during peak traffic.
